steps.note: Ensure counter offers are visible on RFQ rounds.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while retaining the buyer session.
Open the prepared event with the pending counter offer on the vendor overview.
Assert that the vendor sees the pending counter-offer notice.
Assert that the notice includes the original quoted price.
Assert that the notice includes the buyer's offered counter price.
Assert that the buyer's remark is visible.
Assert that Vendor A can accept the counter offer.
Assert that Vendor A can reject the counter offer.
